what_worked: Deterministic scope locking pruned unbounded real-time collaboration before code generation.
FastAPI + Pydantic v2 schemas aligned 1:1 with OpenAPI 3.1 specification.
Next.js 15 App Router wireframes compiled with 100% type safety and zero ESLint errors.
Automated test gates achieved 100% pass rate: 32/32 Pytest endpoint cases and 8/8 Vitest page suites.
Zero high/critical security vulnerabilities across all runtime dependencies.
Instant one-command container boot verified via /healthz runtime probes.
what_failed: Interactive prompt in 'next lint' on cold repositories required pre-configured .eslintrc.json.
Vitest regex matcher ambiguity on loading versus resolved DOM states required specific element selectors.
API create_access_token signature required subject string parameter instead of payload dict.
Stripe checkout mock lacked strict 404 validation for unmapped run identifiers.
what_to_try_next_time: Pre-seed .eslintrc.json during RepoScaffoldAgent (C1) phase to avoid any interactive linter prompts.
Enforce strict DOM data-testid attributes across all wireframe templates for resilient UI assertions.
Introduce an automated type-contract linter verifying Pytest fixtures directly against security functions.
Standardize download token length invariants in the shared Pydantic validation schema.
